name: Timesheet Billing
office_task: When a client's timesheet period closes, draft its invoice in Xero from the hours at our rate card, park what it cannot price, and hold it for a named person to release.
systems_of_record: the job system that holds each client engagement's billing periods, with the time entries filed from the staff's emailed timesheets, and issues the period's id (carried as job_id)

emits.write: One draft invoice in Xero per closed billing period, referenced job:<period id> (and the stage under a fixed-stage contract), every line one of the period's time entries or expenses with its timesheet entry reference in the notes, every rate read from the rate card at draft time, and the client's signed approval attached for out-of-scope hours. A second completion event updates the same draft.
emits.readback: Xero returns the InvoiceID; GET /api.xro/2.0/Invoices/{InvoiceID} must return the invoice with Reference job:<period id>, and that id is stamped on the period as seam.invoice_id. No id back is not a write: it raises invoice.write_failed and the run stops.

emits.write: The invoice leaves only after a release naming the accounts officer, or naming the rule they set and showing the total is under its threshold; the release and the send time are recorded against the period.
emits.readback: GET /api.xro/2.0/Invoices/{InvoiceID} returns it AUTHORISED and sent to the contact, and the period read by its id shows seam.released_by (a person or a rule) before the send time. A send with no release on the record is refused.

emits.write: A parked or waiting invoice as an exception on the billing period: the reason from the standard's fixed list (not_in_pricebook, unsigned_variation, write_failed) or over_threshold, the period id, the invoice id, the codes left unpriced, and exception_owner set to the person the firm named for billing.
emits.readback: The exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading it back returns the job_id, the invoice_id, the reason and the exception_owner; the next run reads it there and stops until exception.closed.

port_of.original_name: Convert emailed timesheets into QuickBooks invoices with OCR, AI, Gmail and Sheets
